hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase

rules: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Maintain the extreme hardware/industrial feel with Chivo.
All tags, SLA timers, commit hashes, version numbers, and metadata must use IBM Plex Mono.
Headings should have tight letter spacing, while overlines and labels must be uppercase with wide letter spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Hierarchy gaps must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading.
Dark mode is the primary theme. Use #1A1D23 as the base app background and #2A2E37 for elevated surfaces.
Use #F2A93C (Warm Amber) sparingly as the primary CTA trigger to guide user action.
Moderation status MUST rigidly use #4C9A5B (Approved), #D9A441 (In-Review), and #C1502E (Rejected).
DO NOT use gradients on backgrounds. The retro-industrial terminal look relies on solid, matte colors.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on overlays or headers. Use dense solid colors to keep data readable.

surfaces.borders: 1px solid #2A2E37 (dark mode) / 1px solid #1A1D23 (light mode) on almost all cards.
surfaces.shadows: Hard shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#0F6E6E] or shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#F2A93C] on hover for interactive elements) to emulate tactile buttons.
surfaces.corners: Sharp. Use rounded-none or maximum rounded-sm to maintain the industrial blocky feel.

textures: Subtle scanline overlays (repeating-linear-gradient) for hero sections and the Admin Anomaly Dashboard.
Monochrome noise overlays on dark surfaces to give a matte, tactile hardware feel.

public_pages.game_hub: Bento Grid (Mode A). Asymmetrical layout with dominant hero games overlapping smaller mod collections. Use gap-8.
public_pages.mod_detail: Split layout. 70% left column for Markdown/Gallery/Changelogs, 30% right sticky sidebar for metadata, dependencies, stats, and download CTA.
public_pages.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 in major sections. Keep it breathable but punchy.

admin_panel.moderation_queue: Dense tabular layout. Every row has strict height. Use Monospace for SLA timers and IDs. Right-aligned status dots (Green/Amber/Red).
admin_panel.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel counts in the Admin view to reduce scroll fatigue.
admin_panel.diff_view: Side-by-side terminal-style diff window for version comparisons. Darker inset background with #4C9A5B additions and #C1502E deletions.

component_strategies.buttons: Tactile, sharp-cornered buttons. Default to primary_brand (#0F6E6E) with text_dark_mode, but on hover, apply a hard transform (-translate-y-1) and hard shadow to pop off the screen.
component_strategies.badges: For trust tiers (new, established, verified), use solid colored 1px borders and uppercase mono text (e.g., border-warning text-warning).
component_strategies.inputs_forms: Square corners. 1px solid borders. Focus state must have a hard 2px ring of Warm Amber (#F2A93C).
component_strategies.mod_upload_wizard: Step-based timeline UI using mono-spaced numbers. Clean, linear layout focusing on one task per screen.
component_strategies.toast_notifications: Use Sonner. Style toasts to look like server log outputs (e.g., '[SUCCESS] Mod version 1.2.4 uploaded').

rules: Motion should feel mechanical and snappy, not soft and bouncy. Keep durations short (150ms - 200ms).
Never use 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition 'transform' and 'background-color' or 'box-shadow'.
Hovering on a mod card should instantly apply a hard shadow and 1px transform, like pressing a physical key.

accessibility.contrast: Adhere to strict WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast. Warm Amber (#F2A93C) must be readable against Charcoal Slate (#1A1D23).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, moderation actions, and tabs MUST include descriptive 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='approve-mod-button').
accessibility.focus_states: All focusable elements must have visible, high-contrast focus rings. Do not rely on color alone for moderation statuses (use icons alongside green/amber/red dots).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts).
Configure Tailwind with the exact Signal & Slate hex codes.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the public-facing pages (Game Hub, Mod Detail) to ensure creative layouts, and Shadcn UI heavily customized for the Admin Panel.
Build the UI in JS, NOT TSX.
For the Admin Panel, build a 'Diff View' component simulating a terminal layout. Use monospace fonts for version comparisons.
Do NOT use soft shadows or rounded-xl/2xl/3xl corners. Everything must feel like physical hardware (sharp, rigid).
Ensure the moderation workflow (Approve/Reject/Quarantine) uses the strict color semantics requested.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are applied to interactive elements for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (centered layouts, simplistic gradients, uniform styling).
Create depth through hard/solid shadows rather than soft blurry dropshadows, keeping the hardware terminal vibe.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., 'transition: all').
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-React with a sharp, linear weight.
Provide micro-animations for hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, cards, links).
Use Sonner for toasts located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
You have .js files not .tsx files, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.
